_about: Public-domain Macarius the Egyptian (4th century; the homilies are now usually assigned to an unknown Syrian writer, Pseudo-Macarius), for the Word Hoard: Fifty Spiritual Homilies of St. Macarius the Egyptian by A. J. Mason (SPCK, 1921) and Primitive Morality, the Spiritual Homilies done into English by a Presbyter of the Church of England (1721), from Internet Archive scans. Mason's own books are on the Arthur James Mason shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

macarius-fifty-homilies-mason-1921: Fifty Spiritual Homilies of St. Macarius the Egyptian, by A. J. Mason, Translations of Christian Literature (London: SPCK; New York: Macmillan, 1921)
macarius-primitive-morality-1721: Primitive Morality: or, The Spiritual Homilies of St. Macarius the Egyptian, done out of Greek into English by a Presbyter of the Church of England (London: W. Taylor; W. and J. Innys; J. Osborn, MDCCXXI)

_alternates.macarius-copies: Four other scans of Mason 1921; the ECCO microfilm of Primitive Morality (1721)

_excluded.macarius-other: Marriott's Macarii Anecdota (1918, Greek text); Macarius Magnes and Macarius of Antioch (different men)
